questions.question: Which period of English was spoken from about 450 to 1100 AD?
questions.explanation: Old English, the Anglo-Saxon period, lasted from about 450 to 1100 AD.

questions.question: What characterises the Middle English period (1100-1500)?
options: Strong Norman French influence on the language
The spread of English to America
questions.explanation: After the Norman Conquest, French heavily influenced English vocabulary in the Middle English period.

questions.question: Which two factors are associated with Early Modern English (1500-1700)?
options: The British Empire and the telegraph
questions.explanation: Early Modern English is the age of Shakespeare and the printing press, which helped standardise the language.

questions.question: Why is English spelling so irregular?
options: It preserves layers of history from different languages and periods
It was designed to be difficult
questions.explanation: English spelling preserves historical layers from Old English, Norse, French, Latin and Greek — hence the irregularity.

questions.question: Which languages have contributed major layers of vocabulary to English?
questions.explanation: English vocabulary contains roots from Latin, Greek, French and Norse, reflecting 1,500 years of contact and conquest.
